title: Two German officials shot dead during routine gun inspection in Bavaria; suspect arrested after overnight standoff
summary: A routine inspection of legally owned firearms turned deadly in Bavaria. Police spent hours negotiating with an armed suspect before storming his home. Follow DW for more.

image.caption: Two local government employees were shot dead during a routine firearms inspection in Berngau, Bavaria, prompting a major police operation that ended with the suspect's arrest Image: Tizian Gerbing/dpa/picture alliance
